address_note: Google Maps no expone direccion de local (service-area business, categoria 'HVAC contractor'). Se usa foto real de un trabajo reciente en vez de mapa embebido (variante adaptada, PIPELINE Fase 3.5).
hours: 8 AM a 8 PM, todos los dias (incluye findes), segun ficha de Google Maps.
website_checked: Ficha de Google Maps NO expone website (rawSnippet muestra literalmente 'Add website'). No se encontro ningun dominio propio en WebSearch de variantes del nombre.
email_source: Busqueda profunda (Fase 1.7): WebSearch '"The Fix-It Guy" HVAC 786-565-6096 Instagram OR Facebook OR email' no devolvio ningun perfil social ni email para este negocio (el unico resultado similar, 'The Fix It Guys Ltd', es una empresa distinta en Aurora, CO, sin relacion). Ficha de Google Maps no expone campo de email. Sin email publico encontrado: campo queda null, no inventado.
contact_channel: Telefono (786) 565-6096, unico canal de contacto publico verificado (click-to-call / SMS).

services_categories_real.evidence: Categoria de Google Maps 'HVAC contractor'. Reseñas de Maynard Brian Emoy y Christhel Alburo describen reparacion de AC y termostato. Fotos de condensadores centrales Trane instalados/reparados.
Texto 'From the owner' de la ficha habla de instalacion de heat pump. Reseña de Reg Lau: 'scheduled an appointment for AC and heater repairs... fixed my furnace quickly'.
3 fotos de Google Maps muestran unidades mini-split Mitsubishi Electric instaladas (exterior, dormitorio, cocina).
Reseña de Christhel Alburo: 'perfectly repaired my broken AC thermostat'.

pricing_note: Negocio de HVAC residencial sin lista de precios publica. Se usa framing 'se cotiza, llama / Call for pricing' para las 4 categorias de servicio evidenciadas arriba.

reviewSamples.author: Reg Lau
reviewSamples.text: Excellent service! I scheduled an appointment for AC and heater repairs, and the technician arrived within the hour. He fixed my furnace quickly and took the time to explain everything along the way. Super helpful and professional. Thanks for the outstanding service!

reviewSamples.author: Joanna Hembra
reviewSamples.text: I can't thank the technician enough for the fantastic work he did on our air conditioner repair. The job was completed to the highest standard, and he provided excellent customer service. He arrived at the scheduled time frame, and I will certainly recommend their HVAC services to everyone I know!

reviewSamples.author: Maynard Brian Emoy
reviewSamples.text: The Fix-It Guy HVAC Repair provides excellent air conditioning repair service and is very reasonably priced. Their technician came on time and repaired my AC problems perfectly. I like that he was a very honest, upfront, and well-rounded guy. It's rare to find companies and technicians like them. Highly recommend this company!

reviewSamples.author: Christhel Alburo
reviewSamples.text: Your technician was quick, polite, very friendly, and very professional. He perfectly repaired my broken AC thermostat in just a matter of time without any problem. I will surely use him again in the future and highly recommend this company to everyone!

photos_note: 7 fotos descargadas de Google Maps via scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js, verificadas con `file` y redimensionadas a max 1000px. Curaduria visual: se seleccionaron 6 (condensador Trane recien instalado en jardin, condensador junto a pared de stucco, condensador bajo terraza/deck, mini-split Mitsubishi exterior, mini-split interior en dormitorio renovado, mini-split interior en cocina). Las 3 interiores (dormitorio/cocina) son fotos de marketing tipo 'ejemplo de instalacion' que el propio negocio subio a su perfil de Google (no hay forma de verificar si son de clientes reales o fotos de catalogo del fabricante/instalador, pero son las que el negocio eligio mostrar publicamente en su ficha). No se descarto ninguna por mala calidad: las 7 eran fotos de trabajo/equipo real, sin selfies ni texto superpuesto.
brand_vibe: HVAC residencial, tecnico y fresco: condensadores metalicos, unidades mini-split blancas, asociacion directa con 'aire fresco'. Encaja con base OSCURA re-tintada a tonos ciano/azul hielo (en vez de champagne dorado), inspirada en template dark (Mizu) para transmitir sensacion de frescor tecnico.
